mission: Make TransformFitAI materially better every two hours for the next two days by combining product design, fitness coaching, nutrition, body-composition trust, behavioral science, visual craft, AI engineering, GTM strategy, influencer-pattern research, and 20-user scenario testing.

per_heartbeat_done_contract: choose one highest-leverage improvement or verification target
inspect current repo state before editing
make a concrete local product, harness, research, or test improvement
run the narrowest relevant deterministic gate
record proof artifact and honest residual risk

external_action_boundary.rule: Do not contact influencers, users, coaches, nutritionists, photographers, or designers; do not imply endorsement; use public-pattern research and simulated panels until Mike gives explicit current-task approval for outreach or spend.

designers.job: Reduce time-to-first-logged-set and make workout logging feel obvious under fatigue.
Keep TransformFitAI visually premium, restrained, accessible, and consistent across all screens.
Shape low-friction transitions, rest timer feedback, haptics, and error recovery without novelty clutter.
Check touch targets, semantic labels, focus order, contrast, dynamic text, and one-handed use.

fitness_coaches.job: Audit progressive overload, RPE/RIR language, set targets, and deload decisions.
Make first workouts safe, confidence-building, and free of jargon traps.
Protect serious lifters' trust: previous set reference, warm-up ramp, rest timing, and PR context.
Handle soreness, low sleep, missed sessions, and regressions without shame or unsafe pressure.

influencer_pattern_board.public_research_target: Jeff Nippard / Stronger By Science ecosystem
influencer_pattern_board.product_lesson: Explain the why behind the set while keeping the logger fast.
Expose volume, proximity to failure, and fatigue tradeoffs without overwhelming beginners.
Coach cues must include safety boundaries and technique reminders at the point of action.
Make progress emotionally legible through small wins, not before/after pressure.
Advanced users need precision, history, and editable logs more than cheerleading.
The app should normalize tiny starts and restarts.
Nutrition support should be practical, non-moralizing, and clear about uncertainty.
Let users see strength, conditioning, recovery, and readiness as one system.
Photography and visual rhythm should make the app aspirational without stock-photo fakery.
Coach voice can be direct while staying safe, specific, and user-controlled.

artists_photographers.job: Prefer real training moments, equipment, hands, plates, sweat, and context over generic stock imagery.
Build the black/gold/orange TransformFitAI visual system around the provided logo without one-note color overuse.
Create iconography and empty states that clarify action, never decorative filler.
Define screenshot storyboards that show the real workout logger, coach, progress, and proof surfaces.

ai_engineers.job: Keep CoachSignal deterministic, source-traced, and visible in the primary user workflows.
Turn every coach-quality claim into test cases, golden examples, and red-team prompts.
Prevent unsafe medical/nutrition claims, body-shame, hidden data use, and unbounded personalization.
Plan offline-safe fallback, observability, local snapshots, and low-latency coach surfaces.

nutritionists.job: Keep macro and recovery suggestions practical, performance-oriented, and scoped.
Avoid moralized food language and support adherence through planning, defaults, and repair.
Flag eating-disorder risk, medical conditions, supplement claims, and cases that need professional care.

behavioral_science_specialists.job: Protect autonomy, competence, and relatedness in every coach intervention.
Reduce activation friction and make the next healthy action obvious.
Design restart flows that convert missed days into plan adjustments, not shame.
Tie progress to identity evidence and lived constraints without hype or false promises.

gtm_strategists.job: Turn the first-open, onboarding, and first-session path into a measurable install-to-activated-user funnel.
Design privacy-safe proof loops and creator-pattern launch motions without endorsement claims or public posting.
Shape screenshot story, subscription/coaching conversion, objection handling, and value proof for Apple and Android.

usable_lessons: progressive overload must choose add rep, add load, hold, reduce, swap, or stop with a reason
